detail.captainAbility: Reduces [Five Elders] [Celestial Dragon] characters' Special charge time by 6 turns at start of quest, reduces crew's Switch Effect and VS Effect gauge by 3 at start of quest, boosts STR, Cerebral, and Slasher characters' ATK by 5.5x, boosts their ATK by approximately 6x when they have [STR][RCV][TND][WANO] or Rainbow slots, boosts crew's HP by 1.3x, makes crew's [STR][RCV][TND] slots have matching slot effects, and if a character's normal attack is effective against the enemy's type, changes that character's slot to [RCV] the next turn [Applies following effect based on number of applicable Character Tags on crew] If 4 or more [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] characters are on the crew, this Captain ability's effects will target the entire crew instead, and reduces crew's Special Bind duration by 10 turns. If a [World Government] [Five Elders] character uses a Special to apply similar effect of [Unknown crew boost icon] that is applied on crew, reduces the boost effect by 25% but changes the effect to a stackable boost (the reduction of the effect cannot go below 1.0; after being changed the effect will not be treated as [Unknown crew boost icon] and can no longer change the effect and turn duration; certain special status will not carry over; stackable with other [Unknown crew boost icon] effects)
detail.captainNotes: The Captain Ability screenshots include one icon-based crew boost mechanic that could not be safely identified by name. The stored text keeps the effect explicit and uses a placeholder for that mechanic.
detail.specialText: Reduces Despair duration by 7 turns. If crew has [Unknown crew status icon A] status when Special is launched, applies Weakened status (increase damage taken by 1.3x for all enemies, damage further increased by 1.3x if enemy has [Unknown enemy status icon B]) to all enemies for 1 turn (ignoring immunity to status effects), then after that, doubles Cerebral and Slasher characters' advantageous class effect for 1 turn, boosts the type effects of STR, Cerebral, and Slasher characters by 3.25x for 1 turn (allows [Unknown stackable boost icon C] and [Unknown crew status icon A] effects to be further increased up to 2 times). If 4 or more [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] characters are on the crew and enemy does not have [Unknown enemy status icon B] status, further increases crew's [Unknown stackable boost icon C] by 1.2x (up to a maximum 10x; this effect also applies to [Unknown stackable boost icon C] from this Special). If 4 or more [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] characters are on the crew and enemy has [Unknown enemy status icon B] status, reduces all enemies' [Unknown enemy status icon B] duration by 5 turns, and further increases crew's [Unknown stackable boost icon C] by 1.2x and [Unknown crew status icon A] by 1.5x (up to a maximum 10x; this effect also applies to [Unknown stackable boost icon C] and [Unknown crew status icon A] from this Special).
detail.specialNotes: The Special screenshots show three icon-based mechanics that could not be safely identified by name: the crew status required when launching the Special and boosted later, the enemy status that amplifies Weakened and whose duration can be reduced, and a separate stackable boost icon that is further increased by the Special.
sailorAbilities: Makes crew's [RCV] slots have matching slot effects, and if field has "Territory: Cerebral class", boosts crew's base stats by 200 (boosts crew's base HP by 200 otherwise).
Reduces crew's Special charge time by 1 turn at start of quest.

vsSpecial.activationRequirement: When number of [STR][DEX][RCV][TND] slots used in normal attacks by crew and number of turns passed totals 12
vsSpecial.activationEffect: Applies "Territory: Cerebral class" to the field (boosts crew's ATK up to 1.5x and reduces damage taken up to 25% based on number of characters matching the territory; territory application is unaffected by VS Effect inability for enemies to remove) for 2 turns, applies -10% STR Resistance to all enemies for 1 turn (resistance application is unaffected by VS Effect inability for enemies to remove), allows healing up to 2x crew's max HP ignoring max HP limit for 1 turn (if HP is above max limit, it is treated as being full HP), changes crew's slots (including [BLOCK] slots) to character's own type unless slots are [TND][RCV], and activates HP Guard of 60% effect for 1 turn

superTandemData.requirement: When an [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] character performs Super Tandem

levels.effect: Raises Boost Level of [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] [Scientist] characters by 1 for 1 turn
Raises Boost Level of [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] [Scientist] characters by 2 for 1 turn
Raises Boost Level of [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] [Scientist] characters by 3 for 1 turn
Raises Boost Level of [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] [Scientist] characters by 4 for 1 turn
Raises Boost Level of [Egghead Arc] [World Government] [Five Elders] [Scientist] characters by 5 for 1 turn

standardResistances: Reduce damage taken from DEX by 30%

effects: Reduce damage taken from DEX by 20%
Increase damage dealt to DEX by 15%

Targets 2 enemies with high current HP for HP 50% reduction; when remaining HP is 80% or above, targets 2 enemies with high current HP for 100% chance of Forced Out (10 s); when remaining HP is 50% or above, targets 3 high DEF enemies for DEF Down Lv.5 (20 s); targets self for HP 20% healing; if 5 or more [Navy] [World Government] [Zoan-type] characters are on the team, targets team for 100% chance to remove ATK Down; targets 3 enemies for ATK x 4 damage.

Targets all enemies for HP 50% reduction; when remaining HP is 80% or above, targets 2 enemies with high current HP for 100% chance of Forced Out (15 s); when remaining HP is 50% or above, targets 3 high DEF enemies for DEF Down Lv.7 (30 s); targets self for HP 50% healing; if 5 or more [Navy] [World Government] [Zoan-type] characters are on the team, targets team for 100% chance to remove ATK Down; targets 3 enemies for ATK x 5 damage; targets all enemies for ATK x 20 spread damage (damage on each enemy reduced based on number of total enemies).

STR-type/Slasher class and [Five Elders] teammates ATK Up Lv.6, SPD Up Lv.6, RCV Up Lv.6; if "Roronoa Zoro" is an enemy, self SPD Up Lv.8, Special CT Speed Up Lv.5; when remaining HP is 80% or above, self ATK Up Lv.8; when receiving damage, up to 20 times, targets self for 10% healing; when dealing damage, up to 10 times, targets self for 10% healing.
